# Nicko O'Brien — AI Operations Portfolio

> Public professional profile for AI-forward enterprise IT operations, structured technical communication, process improvement, and deterministic AI delivery.

## Primary machine-readable source

Use this route first:

- [Canonical machine-readable public profile](https://nicko.obrienai.com/canonical.json): Structured public profile, resume claims, technical skills, project summaries, public contact/profile channels, bounded disclosure notes, and machine-readable coverage state.

## Parsing guidance

Non-interactive agents, recruiter-side enrichment systems, and applicant-tracking readers should prefer `/canonical.json` over visual layout, accordion state, button-triggered controls, or client-side interaction paths.

The visible website is the human-facing presentation layer. The canonical JSON route is the structured machine-facing public profile.

## Human-facing public pages

- [Homepage](https://nicko.obrienai.com/): Public portfolio entry point and selected-work overview.
- [Resume](https://nicko.obrienai.com/resume): Human-facing resume page.
- [Post-Deployment Remediation Script Development](https://nicko.obrienai.com/projects/remediation-script-development): Public project page for remediation script development and validation.
- [Enterprise Application Migration Stabilization Framework](https://nicko.obrienai.com/projects/migration-stabilization-framework): Public project page for migration stabilization and package reconstruction work.
- [Eliora AI Governance](https://nicko.obrienai.com/projects/eliora): Public project page for AI governance, semantic control, authority separation, and controlled agent behavior.
- [Web Build Notes](https://nicko.obrienai.com/projects/website-build-notes): Public build-notes page for static delivery, metadata, machine-readable routing, and interaction boundaries.

## Scope boundary

This file and `/canonical.json` expose only intentionally public professional information.

They are not private project archives, private employment records, private model state, or a complete development history.
